core_obligations: Take a nilpotent element written as x/a^n with x in I^n and clear denominators to obtain a^N x^m = 0 in R for some N (proof lines 17531-17533).
Enlarge N so that it is a multiple m e of the exponent m, turning the relation into (a^e x)^m = 0 (proof lines 17534-17535).
Use reducedness of R to get a^e x = 0, which says precisely that x/a^n is zero in the blowup algebra (proof lines 17535-17536).
proof_roadmap: Clear denominators on a nilpotent fractional element (proof lines 17530-17533).
Arrange the exponent to be a multiple of the nilpotence degree and apply reducedness (proof lines 17533-17537).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if R is reduced then every affine blowup algebra of R is reduced (statement lines 17522-17528, with the author's slogan that being reduced is invariant under blowup). The proof does not exhibit the blowup algebra as a subring of a known reduced ring: it takes a nilpotent element x/a^n, clears denominators to get a^N x^m = 0 in R, adjusts N so that it is a multiple of m in order to read the relation as a power of a^e x, and then applies reducedness of R to conclude x/a^n = 0 (proof lines 17530-17537). The exponent bookkeeping that produces the m-th power is the substance, and the author writes it out. H2.
